svg.title: The whole Study: timber wall kit
svg.desc: Eight source-bound wall elevations, with retained protected openings and local release pockets. Candidate local release geometry only; installed load and occupied handling remain unqualified.
svg.text: The whole Study · hung timber faces
99 moving wall faces · 29 separate skirts · maximum face 5.03 kg
Open the local moulding, lift 10 mm, draw 40 mm. Adjacent faces stay installed.
A separate release pocket at every row
20 mm local pocket − 5 mm setting − 10 mm lift = 5 mm reserve.
Local positive stops prevent lift. Narrow cut faces draw forward on accessible screws.
Corners and protected returns stay fixed. Services and the cornice have independent positive support.
Reference proposal · wall anchors, sealed backing, occupied handling and complete moving assemblies remain unqualified.
Dry Study timber variant. Wet-room performance, whole-floor access and owner acceptance remain separate.
